improved_gouge.name: Improved Gouge

malice.name: Malice
malice.text: Increases your critical strike chance with all attacks and Poisons by {0}%.

ruthlessness.name: Ruthlessness
ruthlessness.text: Gives your finishing moves a {0}% chance to add a Combo Point to your target.

improved_expose_armor.name: Improved Expose Armor
improved_expose_armor.text: Reduces the Energy cost of your Expose Armor ability by {0}, and refunds {1} Combo Points when cast with {2} Combo Points.

improved_slice_and_dice.name: Improved Slice and Dice

blood_splatter.name: Blood Splatter
blood_splatter.text: Increases the duration of your Rupture ability by 6 sec and your Garrote ability by 9 sec.

lethality.name: Lethality

vile_poisons.name: Vile Poisons
vile_poisons.text: Increases the damage dealt by your poisons by {0}% and gives your poisons an additional {1}% chance to resist dispel effects.

cold_blood.name: Cold Blood
cold_blood.text: When activated, increases the critical strike chance of your next Sinister Strike, Backstab, Ambush, Eviscerate, or Mutilate by 100%.

improved_poisons.name: Improved Poisons
improved_poisons.text: Increases the chance to apply Poisons to your target by {0}%, and gives Poison applications a {1}% chance to not consume a charge.

relentless_strikes.name: Relentless Strikes
relentless_strikes.text: Your finishing moves have a {0}% chance per Combo Point to restore {1} Energy.

venom.name: Venom
venom.text: Causes your Shank ability to increase your Poison damage by 30% and your chance to apply Poisons by 20% for 6 sec.

improved_kidney_shot.name: Improved Kidney Shot
improved_kidney_shot.text: Enemies Stunned by your Kidney Shot ability take {0}% increased damage from your poisons and attacks.

seal_fate.name: Seal Fate
seal_fate.text: Your critical strikes from abilities that add Combo Points have a {0}% chance to add an additional Combo Point.

mutilate.name: Mutilate
mutilate.text: Instantly attacks with both weapons for 90% weapon damage plus an additional 40 with each weapon. Damage increased by 20% against Poisoned targets. Awards 2 Combo Points.

coup_de_grace.name: Coup de Grace
coup_de_grace.text: Increases the damage done by your Eviscerate ability by {0}%, and the damage and storage rate of your Death Mark ability by {1}%.

efficient_strikes.name: Efficient Strikes
efficient_strikes.text: Reduces the Energy cost of your Sinister Strike and Hemorrhage abilities by {0}.

puncturing_wounds.name: Puncturing Wounds
puncturing_wounds.text: Increases the critical strike chance of your Backstab by {0}% and your Mutilate by {1}%, and gives Backstab a {2}% chance to add an additional Combo Point.

precision.name: Precision
precision.text: Improves your chance to hit by {0}%.

improved_sprint.name: Improved Sprint
improved_sprint.text: Gives a {0}% chance to remove all movement impairing effects when you activate your Sprint ability.

endurance.name: Endurance
endurance.text: Reduces the cooldown of your Sprint and Evasion abilities by {0}%.

riposte.name: Riposte
riposte.text: A strike that becomes active after parrying an opponent's attack. This attack deals 150% weapon damage and disarms the target for 6 sec.

composure.name: Composure
composure.text: Increases the Energy cost reduction of your Poised ability by {0}.

improved_kick.name: Improved Kick
improved_kick.text: Gives your Kick ability a {0}% chance to Silence the target for {1} sec.

flawless_execution.name: Flawless Execution
flawless_execution.text: Reduces the Energy cost of your Eviscerate ability by {0}.
flawless_execution.note: single rank; the value filled in by hand per this directory README -- a single-rank talent has no variable the importer can identify from its own text

weapon_expertise.name: Weapon Expertise
weapon_expertise.text: Reduces the chance for your attacks to be Dodged or Parried by {0}%.

aggression.name: Aggression
aggression.text: Increases the damage of your Sinister Strike and Eviscerate abilities by {0}%.

dual_wield_specialization.name: Dual Wield Specialization
dual_wield_specialization.text: Increases the damage done by your off-hand weapon by {0}%.

blade_flurry.name: Blade Flurry
blade_flurry.text: Increases your melee attack speed by 20% and your melee attacks strike an additional nearby opponent. Lasts 15 sec.

hack_and_slash.name: Hack and Slash
hack_and_slash.text:
Gives your melee weapon attacks a benefit depending on the weapon.

Axe/Sword: Your successful
melee attacks have a {0}% chance
to trigger an extra attack on the
target.

Dagger/Fist: Increases your
critical strike chance by {1}%.

Mace: Your attacks ignore {2}% of
your target's armor.

flash_of_steel.name: Flash of Steel
flash_of_steel.text: Increases the Energy generated by your Shank ability by {0} and reduces its cooldown by {1} sec.

adrenaline_rush.name: Adrenaline Rush
adrenaline_rush.text: Increases your Energy regeneration rate by 100% for 15 sec.

setup.name: Setup
setup.text: Gives you a {0}% chance to add a Combo Point to your target after Dodging their attack or fully resisting one of their spells.

master_of_deception.name: Master of Deception
master_of_deception.text: Reduces the chance enemies have to detect you while in Stealth mode as if you were {0} level higher.

opportunity.name: Opportunity
opportunity.text: Increases the damage dealt by your Backstab, Garrote, Ambush, and Mutilate abilities by {0}%.

dirty_deeds.name: Dirty Deeds
dirty_deeds.text: Reduces the Energy cost of your Cheap Shot and Garrote abilities by {0}, and your Garrote ability no longer requires you to be behind your target.

camouflage.name: Camouflage
camouflage.text: Reduces your speed penalty from your Stealth ability by {0}% and reduces its cooldown by {1} sec.

improved_ambush.name: Improved Ambush
improved_ambush.text: Increases the critical strike chance of your Ambush ability by {0}%.

dirty_tricks.name: Dirty Tricks
dirty_tricks.text: Reduces the Energy cost of your Sap and Blind abilities by {0}%.

initiative.name: Initiative
initiative.text: Gives you a {0}% chance to add an additional combo point to your target when using your Ambush, Garrote, or Cheap Shot ability.

premeditation.name: Premeditation
premeditation.text: Adds 2 Combo Points to your target. You must add to or use those combo points within 20 sec or the combo points are lost.

serrated_blades.name: Serrated Blades
serrated_blades.text: Causes your attacks to ignore {0}% of your target's Armor and increases the damage dealt by your Rupture ability by {1}%.

elusiveness.name: Elusiveness
elusiveness.text: Reduces the cooldown of your Vanish and Blind abilities by {0} sec.

ghostly_strike.name: Ghostly Strike
ghostly_strike.text: A strike that deals 125% (180% if a Dagger is equipped in your Main Hand) weapon damage, increases your chance to dodge by 15% for 7 sec, and causes your next Ambush or Garrote cast within 7 sec to not require Stealth. Awards 1 combo points.

quick_getaway.name: Quick Getaway
quick_getaway.text: Increases the maximum number of targets you may have Sapped by {0}, and increases your movement speed by {1}% for {2} sec after Sapping a target.

heightened_senses.name: Heightened Senses
heightened_senses.text: Increases your Stealth detection as if you were {0} level higher and reduces your chance to be hit by spells and ranged attacks by {1}%.

preparation.name: Preparation
preparation.text: When activated, this ability immediately finishes the cooldown on your other Rogue abilities.

hemorrhage.name: Hemorrhage
hemorrhage.text: An instant strike that deals 100% weapon damage (145% if a Dagger is equipped) and causes the target to take 15% increased Rupture and Garrote damage from the Rogue. Lasts 15 sec. Awards 1 Combo Points.

boot_knife.name: Boot Knife
boot_knife.text: Grants your Shank ability a {0}% chance to add {1} Combo Points to the target.

death_mark.name: Death Mark
death_mark.text:
Finishing move that marks the target, storing a portion of the damage dealt by your attacks per Combo Point. Garrote and Rupture damage is stored at twice the rate. After 6 sec, the stored damage is dealt, up to a maximum increased by Attack Power and Critical Strike chance:
1 point : 12% stored, (169.95 + 4.12% of attack power) damage cap
2 points: 24% stored, (275.01 + 8.24% of attack power) damage cap
3 points: 36% stored, (380.07 + 12.36% of attack power) damage cap
4 points: 48% stored, (485.13 + 16.48% of attack power) damage cap
5 points: 60% stored, (590.19 + 20.6% of attack power) damage cap
